favorite.section.rei_custom_command.tip:
To add a command,
simply type the commands in the search bar (starting and separated by "/") and press enter.
To name a bookmark,
type some words in front of "/" when adding the bookmark.
(can use "$" for formatting codes)
For more information, please see the main webpage for REI Custom Command.
rei_custom_command.too-many_commands: You can only add up to 10 commands.
